name: Cardslinger
storyline: The Devil has taken hold over the new Frontier, his grasp growing stronger by the day through the gospel of corrupt priests, manifesting crimson vines across the settlements, and dividing the people. Salvation lies in the hands of those called Outlaws, cursed by the devil himself or brave enough to see through his lies, but time is running out
summary: Cardslinger is a singleplayer, weird west, roguelite where you fight your way through the harsh Frontier in grid-based combat to cut out the source of the corruption; the Devil himself. Pick a team of two Outlaws both cursed by the devil. Don trinkets and gather powerful cards to perfect the build and break the curse.
